scope: offline-only strict-OOF Router Recall@50 rescue and Router/P8U blend ablation; no canonical, admission, portfolio, execution, or live change

router.definition: timestamp-local top-50% of the full target-free candidate universe, with deterministic candidate-id tie-breaking

p8u.training_population: all strictly prior-resolved label-valid rows; P8U is trained broadly so it can score and rescue candidates outside the Router top-50%
p8u.geometry: reuse each outer fold's immutable source NMF bundle exactly; no geometry fit, alignment, or head-HPO is rerun
p8u.score_normalization: within-timestamp deterministic percentile rank, computed target-free independently for Router and P8U before blending

evaluation.selection_rule: all arms retain exactly the same timestamp-local 50% capacity; rescue P8U choices are taken only from the non-Router-selected remainder

controls.selection: no arm is promoted or selected on held results; pooled and per-quarter metrics are reported for falsification only
